resource: ItemInstances stored in one House interior, including container contents
allocation_impact: The House advisory/assignment/access locks serialize the count before the one-item insertion. A container with contents is refused, so this shape never imports uncounted descendants. At 2,000 the next placement returns typed HouseWriterError::StorageFull before reservation commit, custody or audit changes; no truncation.
boundary_tests: 1,999 independently seeded inactive occupancy DATA plus a genuine current actor/native item placement reaches 2,000
the next actual placement is refused StorageFull without source, event or reservation changes
empty containers are admitted; containers with contents are refused before write
notes: Accepted HOUSE-OWN-0 §§7/12 (HOUSEOWN0-RL-14); HOUSE_RUNTIME0 §6.1 and HOUSE_RT_INBOX_PACKETS §1.3/§2.1. This storage count is separate from the 200-Character scope admission limit HOUSERT0-RL-03. Test occupancy is synthetic inactive DATA, never current actor/session/access authority or a 100-Character capacity claim.
